headline: Nevish Line Battles Intensify as Severe Attrition Sweeps Northern Fronts
war_summary: Nevish Line has escalated into the war's most volatile sector, logging twenty base exchanges over the past two hours with fierce contests over Princefal, Blackcoat Way, and Grief Mother as casualties surge on both sides. In Weathered Expanse, structural transfers slowed to a single event over two hours, yet fighting intensified drastically with hourly casualties exceeding three thousand combined across disputed ground at Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance. Along Kuura Strand, fighting rekindled with two recent base shifts centering on Faden Point. The bloody central front at Linn of Mercy saw casualties accelerate sharply to over six hundred per hour for both factions, though ownership lines held firm. Meanwhile, the violent surge previously reported in the Dead Lands cooled considerably, with Warden losses tapering off from their earlier peak. Elsewhere, Marban Hollow and Godcrofts remained structurally static following earlier upheaval, and the deep Colonial southern heartlands continue to report minimal contact.
